description: [Lazylibrarian](https://lazylibrarian.gitlab.io/) is a program to follow authors and grab metadata for all your digital reading needs. It uses a combination of HardCover, OpenLibrary, Librarything, GoodReads, and optionally GoogleBooks as sources for author info and book info.
